visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs wearing a black leather jacket and a cream-colored headset around her neck stands next to a bright green kiosk labeled 'Pocket Change'. She smiles and gestures toward the screen with her right hand in a bright, indoor airport setting. (2) The camera cuts to a wider shot of an airport hallway with signs overhead for 'International Departures' and 'Train' in English and Japanese. A large Mario graphic is visible on a pillar as people with luggage walk through the corridor. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hand interacting with the green kiosk's touchscreen, selecting various options like 'Japan Service' and 'Suica'. She is holding a small brown wallet with a character charm. (4) The woman feeds a 1000 yen bill into the machine's bill slot and then holds her smartphone against the digital card reader on the kiosk. The lighting is bright and even. (5) A close-up shows the bill slot repeatedly rejecting the 1000 yen bill, pulling it in slightly and then pushing it back out. The woman's hands hold the rejected bill with a look of confusion as she tries to re-insert it.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: Pocket Change. [Subtitle]: 是可以把你在日本剩下的零錢. (2) [Subtitle]: 全部通通儲值到西瓜卡裡面. (3) [Subtitle]: 位置在入境大廳1F右轉 經過任天堂看板 繼續直走的右邊. (4) [Subtitle]: 它有繁體中文 然後按開始. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後你要按「日本服務」. (6) [Subtitle]: 最後西瓜卡按確定 就可以把你的錢放進去. (7) [Subtitle]: 假如你剩非常多零錢的話. [Variety]: (但這台好像怪怪的無法辨識). (8) [Subtitle]: 可以把零錢投進去. [Slogan]: 請按確定即可完成. (9) [Subtitle]: 可以可以已完成. [Slogan]: 請領取收據 謝謝您的使用. (10) [Subtitle]: 這台唯一的缺點是我的零錢沒辦法辨識 新鈔好像也不行. [Variety]: 什麼意思為什麼這張不行? (11) [Subtitle]: 但網路上說可以使用 我們猜是這台機器的問題. [Variety]: 蛤...有差嗎? [Variety]: 感覺是機器的問題 大家在機場看到也試試看.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice speaks quickly over an upbeat, synth-driven pop BGM with a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. Faint airport room tone is present. (2) Vocal tone remains bright and instructional as the speaker describes directions. A soft 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during a visual scene change. (3) High-pitched digital 'beeps' trigger as the screen is touched. The music continues at a consistent volume. (4) Distinct mechanical whirring and a metallic 'click' sound as the bill is accepted and then rejected by the machine. The female voice exhibits a rising, questioning pitch. (5) The mechanical rejection sound repeats twice more. A bubbly 'pop' sound effect emphasizes a text overlay. The speaker ends with a slightly lower arousal, concluding her thought as the music fades slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a practical tutorial for travelers in Japan on how to use 'Pocket Change' machines to convert leftover coins and bills into e-money like Suica, while also sharing a real-world troubleshooting experience when the machine malfunctions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video appears to be a personal travel tip vlog rather than a paid advertisement, as it highlights a technical failure/difficulty with the machine.
